status: qualified references; pending pilot and formal freeze
selection: first joint numerical and topology acceptance

cases.user_requirement: Generate an inverting op-amp amplifier with a gain of -10, built with an input resistor, feedback resistor, grounded non-inverting input, dual supply symbols, and an output connector.
Create a non-inverting op-amp amplifier with a gain of +11, built with a resistor divider feedback network, AC-coupled input, output connector, and power supply symbols.
Design a common-emitter NPN transistor amplifier with a voltage gain of ~-10, built with a collector resistor, emitter resistor, input coupling capacitor, output coupling capacitor, and bias divider.
Build an electret microphone preamplifier with a gain of ~100 using a microphone input, bias resistor, coupling capacitor, op-amp gain stage, and output connector.
Create a passive RC low-pass filter with a ~1 kHz cutoff, built with input and output connectors, one series resistor, one shunt capacitor to ground, and labeled output node.
Design an active first-order low-pass filter with a ~1 kHz cutoff using an op-amp buffer, resistor-capacitor input network, power symbols, and output connector.
Create a 5.1 V Zener reference circuit with input resistor, a 5.1 V Zener diode to ground, decoupling capacitor, input connector, and output connector.

Build a single-supply non-inverting op-amp audio preamplifier with a gain of ~11, built with an AC-coupled input, virtual ground bias divider, feedback gain network, output coupling capacitor, and input/output connectors.
Generate a 1 kHz active low-pass filter using a single op-amp, input resistor, feedback capacitor, feedback resistor, output connector, supply decoupling, and ground.
Design a constant-current LED driver delivering about 20 mA using an op-amp current sense loop, N-channel MOSFET, sense resistor, LED load connector, input power connector, and supply decoupling.
Design a loaded inverting op-amp amplifier with a gain of -5 at 1 kHz, dual 5 V supplies and a 2 kohm output load.

Design a four-resistor op-amp difference amplifier with a differential gain of 5 at 1 kHz and dual 12 V supplies. With both inputs driven by the same 1 V AC signal, the output AC magnitude must not exceed 0.01 V.

Design a common-emitter NPN amplifier with a gain of -5 at 1 kHz, an unbypassed emitter-degeneration resistor, input and output coupling capacitors, a bias divider, a 12 V supply and a 4.7 kohm output load.

Design a two-stage common-emitter NPN amplifier with a total gain of +25 at 1 kHz. Use two capacitively coupled transistor stages, independent bias dividers and emitter resistors, a 12 V supply and a 10 kohm output load.
Design a low-pass filter comprising two sequential RC sections, each followed by an op-amp buffer, with an overall cutoff of 500 Hz and unity passband gain. Use dual 12 V supplies.

Design a unity-gain Sallen-Key low-pass filter with a Butterworth response and a cutoff of 2000 Hz using dual 12 V supplies. Use one op-amp buffer and the two-resistor, two-capacitor Sallen-Key feedback network.
Design a loaded 5.1 V Zener reference with a series feed resistor and a 1 kohm output load. The output must meet the voltage target at both 9 V and 12 V input supplies.
Design a 4.4 V regulated output using a 5.1 V Zener reference and an NPN emitter-follower buffer from a 12 V supply. Meet the output target with both 470 ohm and 1 kohm loads.
Design a constant-current LED driver delivering 10 mA from a 5 V supply using an op-amp current-sense loop, an N-channel MOSFET, a sense resistor, a resistor-divider reference and supply decoupling.

Design a constant-current LED sink delivering 6 mA at both 9 V and 12 V supplies. Use two NPN transistors: a pass transistor in the LED branch and a feedback transistor sensing its emitter-resistor voltage and controlling its base.
